display_long_description:
Bring your TV experience into an immersive space with DIRECTV on Meta Quest. You can stream live TV, sports, news, movies, and On Demand content — without sitting in front of a traditional TV. Catch sporting events, news, and family-friendly movies on demand.  
•	Live sports including MLB® games, pro basketball, and world-class soccer with FIFA World Cup on Fox, FS1 and Telemundo  
•	Stream your content whether you have a Genre Pack®, a full channel lineup, or a MyFree DIRECTV account  which offers 150+ live channels and thousands of hit movies and tv shows on demand—all completely free
•	Local, regional and national news coverage*  
•	Your favorite series and movies  
•	Spanish language channel lineups  
  
NOTE: Availability of programming varies by in-browser access and subscription package / add-ons. US ONLY.  *Some local channels not available in select markets.
